usedFor: Pivotal Tracker holds software stories and projects, and “New Project” there can create a deal or contact in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in Pivotal Tracker, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new project gives sales a deal to follow in HubSpot.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so map one before a “New Story” run reaches HubSpot.
